data.exact_reserve_text: During 2018, gross ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2016 & prior) increased marginally by $0.6m (approximately $0.2m net). However, this is the result of a significant reduction in premium of $35.6m gross (approx. $14.0m net), offset by an increase of $25.1m gross (approx. $10.0m net) due to underlying claims deterioration. The drivers of the adverse experience are, most notably, from the Professional classes. There was also adverse experience on Aviation (Aerospace and General Aviation), Accident & Health and Aon Client Treaty, offset by favourable experience in Technical risks.

data.standardized_narrative: Prior-year (2016 & prior) gross reserves showed a marginal adverse movement of $0.6m in 2018. This small net strengthening reflects a combination of a large reduction in premiums written (c.$35.6m gross) partly offset by underlying claims deterioration (c.$25.1m gross), driven primarily by adverse development in Professional Indemnity and deterioration in Aviation, Accident & Health and Aon Client Treaty, with favourable experience in Technical risks.

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts reported in the syndicate's presentation currency (USD). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position - Technical provisions (Claims outstanding gross) 2017 comparative column (page 18). Prior year development gross amount taken from explicit narrative sentence on claims split by reporting year (page 41) which states a $0.6m gross increase. A gross claims development triangle is present (gross table) and was not required to compute the PYD because the narrative provided an explicit gross figure. Premium mix taken from Class of business analysis (note) on page 27. Some LOB mappings (e.g. 'Aon Client Treaty' -> Treaty, 'Professional Indemnity' -> Professional Lines, 'Technical risks' -> Energy) are inferred for lob_movements. Reported confidence reflects explicit statements where available.
